title: Gekijouban Mazinger Z: Infinity
justification: Checked by episode title against TVDB series 83609. The film is TMDB movie 452970 (Mazinger Z: Infinity (2017)). Anime-Lists has no TVDB id for this node; it takes series 83609. AniDB episode 1 "Complete Movie" (the anime "劇場版マジンガーZ / INFINITY") is TVDB S0E4 "Mazinger Z: Infinity"; AniDB S1 "Interviews to Mazinga Z Infinity creators" has no TVDB episode (its default TVDB S0E1 is "Mazinger Z vs. Devilman", another item). TVDB series 83609 Mazinger Z lists the film in season 0 as S0E4 Mazinger Z: Infinity (2018-01-13), beside the franchise's other films, so the node maps there rather than to the movie marker, and keeps TMDB movie 452970 and IMDb tt6470762.
